C. The Employer agrees to commence negotiation with the MOSES, upon MOSES' request, regarding the subject of full time paid leave for union business in the event that the necessary provisions of the Massachusetts General Laws are amended to allow the parties to bargain for such leave.

The Provisions of this Memorandum of Understanding shall be coterminous with the duration of this collective bargaining agreement as provided in Article 29.
